ticket.summary: Only toilet in home fully blocked, bowl near overflow after flush, plunger failed; other drains draining normally so likely local clog - first priority slot booked.
mitigation_advice: Do not flush again and do not re-plunge while the bowl is full (overflow risk).
Optional: close the toilet's own supply shutoff valve - small oval/football handle on the supply line behind the toilet, clockwise until snug, to prevent an accidental flush overflowing [PB-01].
ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Aiden - a Brookdale plumber will be at 5 Coppersmith Ave tomorrow (Mon Sep 1) at 8:00 AM, about 45 minutes on site, flat $149 to auger the toilet clear. Tonight: no flushing, no plunger; optionally close the toilet's supply shutoff valve behind the toilet [PB-01]. If water starts backing up into the tub/shower or the bowl overflows, text back and we'll page the on-call plumber.
